resources.string: Recoverable KernelSU fixes and carefully controlled debloat profiles for Galaxy S23 devices
Independent, recoverable fixes for Recent Apps, Quick Search, Circle to Search and optional package controls.
Nothing is disabled by installing this update. Core fixes and Debloat Profiles are separate, and the app never deletes APKs or app data.

Root gives an app full system access. EvoX Quick Fix supports KernelSU on Android 16 only. Launcher3 supplies Recents and Circle integration; Vector is needed only for Back Guard; Quick Search is needed only for the verified Back Guard setup. Debloat is optional: every package starts on Keep, and only packages you select are disabled for user 0. Read Help before changing anything and keep ADB/Recovery available.

If Android does not boot, disable the two systemless modules from ADB/Recovery and restart:

adb shell su -c 'touch /data/adb/modules/evox_contextual_search_fix/disable; touch /data/adb/modules/evox_overview_transparency/disable; reboot'

Back Guard is removed by disabling EvoX Quick Fix in Vector and restarting Quick Search.

KernelSU grants controlled root access. Magic Mount-rs lets a small module add a missing system feature without editing /system. Launcher3 provides Quickstep/Recents. Quick Search is your HOME app. Vector loads the Back Guard hook only inside Quick Search. Google provides Circle to Search. Debloat Profiles only disable selected packages for user 0 and keep an ownership ledger for exact rollback.

Fully tested: SM-S918B on Android 16, user 0, KernelSU. Experimental: SM-S911* and SM-S916*. S23 FE, Magisk, work profiles and secondary users are not supported. Transparency and Back Guard stay locked to the verified SM-S918B environment.

Root and package disabling can break boot, calls, emergency alerts or apps. Start with one optional package. The app never runs Disable All, never uses pm uninstall and never clears data. Keep a real backup and ADB/Recovery access.
No analytics, no INTERNET permission, no automatic links and no terminal. All checks and ledgers stay on the device.
